name: Nest Basis Vault
oneLiner: nBASIS is Nest's NAV basis vault combining USTB Treasury and Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund (USCC, formerly Superstate USCC); NAV varies and is not a fixed 1:1 peg.
collateral: Current Nest data shows small liquid USDC/USDT/pUSD plus Superstate USTB and Superstate USCC only; the current USCC fund is presented as the Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund (formerly Superstate USCC). The current page snapshot is 0.63% liquid, 11.7% USTB, and 87.7% USCC.
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and drifts with the basis-trade strategy NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

notices.title: Active strategy, not par stablecoin
notices.message: nBASIS runs a basis-trade strategy whose value drifts with funding-rate performance. It is closer in profile to Midas mRe7YIELD than to a 1:1 stablecoin, and Pharos lists it because its primary reference is the U.S. dollar.
